question: Can you use CytoConverter genomic coordinates to calculate the frequency of chromosomal gains and losses across a cohort of breast cancer (morphology='3111') and adenocarcinoma (topology='0401') samples? Concretely, please include the number and frequency (2 decimals in percentage) of amplifications (gains of more than 1 copy), gains (1 extra copy), losses (1 copy) and homozygous deletions (loss of 2 copies) for each chromosomal band. And sort the result by the ordinal of each chromosome and the starting-ending base-pair position of each band in ascending order.
sql:
WITH filtered_samples AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT c.RefNo, c.CaseNo
    FROM `mitelman-db.prod.Cytogen` c
    WHERE c.Morph = '3111' AND c.Topo = '0401'
),
total_count AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) as total_samples FROM filtered_samples
),
band_events AS (
    SELECT 
        cb.cytoband_name,
        cb.chromosome,
        cb.hg38_start,
        cb.hg38_stop,
        cc.ChrOrd,
        cc.RefNo,
        cc.CaseNo,
        cc.Type
    FROM `mitelman-db.prod.CytoConverted` cc
    JOIN filtered_samples fs ON cc.RefNo = fs.RefNo AND cc.CaseNo = fs.CaseNo
    JOIN `mitelman-db.prod.CytoBands_hg38` cb ON cc.Chr = cb.chromosome
        AND cc.Start < cb.hg38_stop
        AND cc.End > cb.hg38_start
)
SELECT 
    b.cytoband_name,
    b.chromosome,
    b.hg38_start,
    b.hg38_stop,
    b.ChrOrd,
    0 as amplifications,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN b.Type = 'Gain' THEN CONCAT(b.RefNo, '_', b.CaseNo) END) as gains,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN b.Type = 'Loss' THEN CONCAT(b.RefNo, '_', b.CaseNo) END) as losses,
    0 as homozygous_deletions,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(0 * 100.0, tc.total_samples) as amplification_freq,
    ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN b.Type = 'Gain' THEN CONCAT(b.RefNo, '_', b.CaseNo) END) * 100.0, tc.total_samples), 2) as gain_freq,
    ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN b.Type = 'Loss' THEN CONCAT(b.RefNo, '_', b.CaseNo) END) * 100.0, tc.total_samples), 2) as loss_freq,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(0 * 100.0, tc.total_samples) as homozygous_deletion_freq
FROM band_events b
CROSS JOIN total_count tc
GROUP BY b.cytoband_name, b.chromosome, b.hg38_start, b.hg38_stop, b.ChrOrd, tc.total_samples
ORDER BY b.ChrOrd, b.hg38_start
